name: sing
description: 노래 합성 DSP — 악보(음표+가사 음절)와 말한 목소리 wav 를 받아 음정·박자를 악보대로 재합성하고 반주를 얹어 노래 wav 를 만듭니다. 채팅에서 부르는 표면은 `sing` 코어 도구입니다.

action.description: render = score (+ optional spoken vocal wav) -> song wav on disk. selftest = self-checks, no files needed.

score.description: The song. {bpm, notes:[{syl, note, beats}], chords?:[{root, beats, quality?}], style?, band?, meter?, swing?, comp?, bassline?} — note/root are pitch names like 'G4'/'C3'; beats are quarter-note counts; syl is the syllable sung on that note ('-' extends the previous one). style is a genre row (groove + feel + default band): trot | ballad | rock | metal | pop | dance | rnb | rocknroll | march | classic | newage | none, with aliases edm/house/kpop/jpop/waltz — an unknown style is refused with the full list.

band.description: Per-part instrument override {melody?, chord?, bass?} from the module's library — electric/acoustic guitar, e-violin, synth/square leads, synth bass, piano, e-piano, organ, accordion, strings, brass, flute, marimba, bell, music box. An unknown name is refused with the full list in the error, so guessing is safe. Omitted parts keep the style's own band.

meter.description: Beats per bar: 4 (default) or 3 (waltz — its own drum grooves).

swing.description: 0-1: how late the rhythm section's offbeat eighths lean (0 straight, 1 full shuffle). Omit for the style's default (trot swings lightly). The melody always stays straight.

comp.description: How the chord part moves: pad (held) | stabs (offbeat strokes) | arp (rippling eighths) | quarters. Omit for the style's default.

bassline.description: How the bass moves: hold (whole notes + walk into the next chord) | twobeat (root-fifth alternation) | alt (marching quarters). Omit for the style's default.

vocalPath.description: Workspace-relative path of the spoken vocal wav (the TTS output, one take of all lyrics in note order). Omitted = instrumental only.

scoreMediaPath.description: MIDI file to use as the score when `score` is omitted — a media URL (/user/media/<slug>.mid), a workspace path, or the ALIAS of a score shelved in the module's 악보 보관함 setting. An unknown alias is refused with the full shelf list; omitted with exactly one shelved score = that one. Karaoke MIDIs bring their own lyrics; the parsed score comes back in data.score for correction.

lyrics.description: Syllable string to lay onto MIDI notes in order (used only when the MIDI has no lyric events). Whitespace ignored; extra notes become melisma '-'.

style.description: Style (genre) override when the score comes from MIDI — any style name the score contract accepts; an unknown one is refused with the full list.

outPath.description: Workspace-relative output wav path. Default data/sing/out-<hash>.wav

midiOut.description: Also write the arrangement as a .mid beside the wav. The wav is limited by this module's one tone generator; the .mid is not — open it in anything and the parts (melody / chord / bass / drums) arrive on their own tracks.

midiOutPath.description: Workspace-relative .mid path. Implies midiOut. Default = the wav path with a .mid extension.

settings_fields.label: 악보 보관함 (MIDI · 오디오)
settings_fields.description: 악보를 여러 개 올려 두고 별칭으로 부릅니다 — "캐논 기타버전으로 연주해줘"처럼요. 파일은 미디어 보관함에 저장되고 여기에는 목록만 남습니다.
